title: Newsletters — Localising newsletters
slide_intent: Connect a newsletter’s length and production method to its first read. A short office publication has to start delivering the story on its cover.
strategic_value: The program masthead can identify the publisher across a desktop-printed newsletter and a professionally printed magazine.
demonstration: Two Connect covers share a red masthead and upper-right program mark. One opens into columns of text and a sidebar. The other gives the page to an athlete photograph, a headline and sponsor credits.
practical_value: Use the text-led, nonbleed layout for a short desktop issue. For a longer professionally produced issue, test a full-bleed photograph with readable headline space.

content_islands.name: Production notes
content_islands.spec: Place six numbered considerations beside the covers. Connect the numbers to the masthead, highlights, image text and partner area.

content_islands.name: Short newsletter
content_islands.spec: Show a compact, nonbleed cover at left with story columns and a contrasting sidebar. Caption the 1–4 page use case underneath.

content_islands.name: Long newsletter
content_islands.spec: Place the magazine-style cover at right with a full-page athlete photograph. Separate the program mark at the top from partner recognition at the foot.
